name: Nyan Hunt
source:
The royal highness has ordered the captain to sail towards the uncharted to find a rare national treasure which is an unknown character with cat ears and tail. They provided all the information and resources he can get only to realize what he learned can be tossed into the ocean.

[From [url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/nyan-hunt]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
王子殿下命令船长驶向未知的海域，寻找稀有的国宝，这是一个长着猫耳和尾巴的无名人物。他们提供了他能得到的所有信息和资源，却发现他所学到的东西可以扔进大海。

[来自[url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/nyan-hunt]Itch.io[/url]]
